meta.note: Verified 2026-08-14: all nine match GET /api/v1/catalog/rates/ exactly. These are now CHARGING rates, not display-only — checkout sends the on-screen currency, so what this table renders is what Stripe bills. Proven end to end: a 10 GB Saudi plan renders ₹1,359.00 here and its PaymentIntent is 135900 INR. Keep in step with the backend: fx.current_rates() and fx.latest_rate() both resolve through latest_rate, so a stored FxRate row beats settings.FX_RATES in BOTH, and a change there needs `npm run catalog` here or the storefront quotes a price it will not charge.
